description: This file defines the InMemoryReminderTable class implementing a reminder table interface for Orleans, managing reminder data using an in-memory grain, with lifecycle participation for availability management.

classes.name: InMemoryReminderTable
classes.description: Implements IReminderTable and ILifecycleParticipant for in-memory reminder data management in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table (no-op, completes immediately).

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry by grainId and reminderName from the reminder grain.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads all reminders for a specific grainId.

methods.name: ReadRows (uint begin, uint end)
methods.description: Reads a range of reminders, returns an empty dataset if not available.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder entry identified by grainId, reminderName, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table, intended for testing purposes.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Creates or updates a reminder entry.

methods.name: ThrowIfNotAvailable
methods.description: Checks the availability flag and throws if the service is not available.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to lifecycle events to set the availability status on startup and shutdown.
